name: page-side-shader-compositor-unavailable
description: A browser whose html-in-canvas form the composition's shader-transitions build does not know (Chrome 157 replaced canvas layoutsubtree with content="drawable"): the page deletes layoutSubtree before the build loads, so its page-side compositor declines to install. The shader transition must still render, blended on the Node-side layered path, instead of the bare opacity flip.
